nativeArtPolicy: Every selected raw/master pair is byte-identical. No alpha cleanup, painting, recoloring, crop, per-pose scaling, source padding or source pixel modification. Separate technical export/QA composites only.
semanticContract: idle/walk-a/carry-or-work/walk-b. Carry-or-work is a protective escort halt signal using the existing shield. Catalog availability does not imply authored gameplay use.
sourceAnomalyResolution: Legacy source idle/work cells repeat effectively the same stance and both walk cells repeat the same contact. New work clearly signals halt and walking poses have opposite leading boots. Stable original costume/equipment retained.
palettePolicy: Preserve warm light-tan woman, brown low bun, dark teal scarf, muted blue-gray coat with cream trims, brown scale vest/belt/boots, blank tan tags, tan rope and brass keys; round wood shield with gray rim/boss. No faction recolor or invented markings.

idle.review: Brown-haired adult woman with low bun, dark teal scarf, blue-gray cream-trim coat and brown scale vest; both boots planted, near hand rests over sheathed short blade, far forearm supports round wood-and-gray-metal shield. Functional rope, blank tags and keys remain at belt.

walk-a.review: Near screen-left boot swings forward heel-first, broad underside visible. Screen-right boot stays behind. Free near arm swings back and down; far arm carries same shield. Same face direction, equipment and body scale.

carry-or-work.review: Actual escort halt action: near screen-left hand extends open palm toward route with five fingers. Far forearm raises the same shield protectively before chest. Two boots brace apart; blade remains sheathed. Exactly two arms and hands; far grip naturally hidden behind shield. No extra hand at belt.

walk-b.review: Opposite walking contact: far screen-right boot moves forward heel-first with visible underside, near screen-left boot remains behind. Free hand swings forward near belt. Same face direction and equipment, no mirrored identity.
